HTMLEscape.claim: Appends the visible HTML-escaped bytes to the existing buffer, preserves its visible prefix, and faults on a nil buffer.
HTMLEscape.limits: Finite disjoint source and destination buffers with valid geometry and feasible allocations. Public buffer internal capacity, unread offset behavior, concurrency and allocation failure are outside scope. The alternate legacy build was not replayed.
HTMLEscape.configurations: Pinned Go 1.27.0 default JSON v2 source selection and direct same-package overlay on darwin/arm64. Byte-span oracle checks untouched bytes, lowercase sequences and the staged append state on capacity transitions. 7,056 boundaries and 60,000 samples at 17, 2718 and 65537.
